name: Goi nhech
summary: Gỏi nhệch is the eel-goby salad of Nghĩa Hưng. Báo Nam Định describes the Quần Vinh plate at Nghĩa Thắng: two fish, thính from gạo Tám, mẻ, galangal, and turmeric. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nghĩa Hưng. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 names gỏi nhệch Nghĩa Hưng. Báo Nam Định on 30 January 2023 also lists it for the coast of Hải Hậu, Nghĩa Hưng, and Giao Thủy. The Quần Vinh sentences place it at Nghĩa Thắng, Nghĩa Hưng.
texture: Báo Nam Định distinguishes nhệch khét, finger-sized and the one it calls best, from nhệch củ on the flats, sometimes 1.5 kg and 1.2 m. Slime is worked off in strong salt water. Meat is sliced along the grain and dusted with galangal, roasted Tám-rice thính mixed with mung-bean flour, and fresh turmeric, unless the fish is already yellow.
taste: Dấm mẻ is Tám rice cooled and started with mẻ. Shrimp paste goes in before the boil or after it is cooked. Báo Nam Định says adding shrimp paste to a boiling pot makes the mẻ smell off. Bones are fried crisp. The gall goes into rice wine. Herbs and sour fruit come with the plate. A rice-paper roll was not described.
howToEat: As gỏi, with the herbs and the mẻ. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Quần Vinh, Nghĩa Thắng, Nghĩa Hưng. The 30 January 2023 coast list also names Hải Hậu and Giao Thủy. All stay. A door was not printed. Check on arrival.

seoDescription: Eel-goby salad at Quần Vinh, Nghĩa Hưng, with Tám-rice thính and mẻ. Hải Hậu and Giao Thủy are also named. A price is Check on arrival.
